name: RedTippingAuto
note: start must equal the pose RedTippingAuto.initializeRobot gives Odometry: (171.5 + 1218, 3658 - 171.5, -90 deg)

name: RedDecideAuto
note: start must equal the pose RedDecideAuto.initializeRobot gives Odometry: (171.5 + 1218, 3658 - RobotFootprint.BACK_MM, -90 deg); BACK_MM is 252 now, so y = 3406. decide() picks every move after the preload.

name: RedDecideAutoPartnerFirst
note: RedDecideAuto for when the partner shoots first from the up side (use partner red_partner_up_side). Start must equal the pose it gives Odometry: (1500, BACK_MM = 252, +90 deg). It waits until Cell B is up, then decides like RedDecideAuto.

name: RedDecideAutoNotSolo
note: STRONG partner (NOT SOLO): use partner red_partner_strong. Same start as partner-first; each robot stays strictly on its own half: the partner works the A half (Flower A, Garden, spill, shoots A), we work the B half (Flower B, B-side loose balls, shoot B).

name: BallShowcaseAuto
note: sim-only: the real shooter, intake, stopper and turret code drives, picks up and shoots. Start must equal the pose it gives Odometry.
